hazlet.name: Hazlet Township

schedules.area_note: Zones 1–8; locate zone via alphabetical street list in Green Booklet 2026, then follow that zone’s printed recycling pickup dates for the year.

Brush and bagged leaves: six curbside collections per year per zone on dates in Green Booklet 2026; place out no earlier than seven days before scheduled date; brush max 4 ft length and 4 in diameter; leaves in brown paper biodegradable bags.

White metal (large appliances and metal items): four curbside collections per year per zone on dates in Green Booklet 2026, or drop off at recycling yard during operating hours; curbside by 7:00 a.m. on scheduled day.
Two residential curbside bulk pickups per year by appointment; zones 1–4 on Tuesdays, zones 5–8 on Thursdays; program pauses mid-November through early spring; call DPW to schedule.

dropoff.name: Hazlet Township DPW Recycling Yard
dropoff.hours: Regular: Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m., Sat 8:15 a.m.–1:45 p.m., Sun closed; Memorial Day–Labor Day weekdays 7:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; closed municipal holidays

hazlet.notes: Municipal site publishes recycling, yard waste, white metal, and bulk programs; regular household trash collection days are not published (residents use private garbage contractors per Green Booklet). Grass clippings are not collected curbside or accepted at the recycling yard.

highlands.name: Borough of Highlands

schedules.area_note: Zones 1 and 3: 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month; no residential recycling on the fifth Wednesday of a month
Zones 2 and 4: 2nd and 4th Wednesday of each month; no residential recycling on the fifth Wednesday of a month

Regular bulk by zone on first Friday (zone 1), second Friday (zone 2), third Friday (zone 3), fourth Friday (zone 4) in March, June, September, and December; additional permit bulk/Freon pickups 2nd and 4th Monday of month ($50 permit at Borough Hall)
Brush by zone on Fridays in April, October, and December (zone 4 also has additional June brush per 2026 calendar); leaves picked up October, November, and December

dropoff.name: Highlands Borough Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., Sat 7:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m., Sun closed

highlands.notes: Curbside trash and recycling issues: contact Surburban/Roselle Disposal at 973-675-5451. No trash pickup on Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s Day (2026 calendar).

interlaken.name: Borough of Interlaken

schedules.area_note: Regular refuse; holiday pickup moves to next day
Regular refuse; holiday pickup moves to next day
All recyclables (bottles, cans, glass, plastic, corrugated cardboard, newspaper, mixed paper); 1st and 3rd Tuesday; place at curb before 7:00 a.m.; recycling must be loose, not in plastic bags

4th Monday of each month except October, November, and December; 2026 last bulk 2026-09-28, suspended Oct–Dec 2026, resumes 2027-01-25 (borough homepage); place curbside before 7:00 a.m. (not before 7:00 p.m. evening prior)
Brush, branches, leaves: Mon–Thu collection; one pile per household, max 4 ft limbs, 1 ft from curb. Grass clippings and dirt: Tue–Thu only, containerized up to 40 lb.
Metals on 4th Monday of month; $15 fee for items containing freon; call Borough Hall 732-531-7405 for appointment

interlaken.notes: Borough Public Works conducts curbside collection. No municipal drop-off site listed on borough site; homepage references Monmouth County Reclamation Center for household items when bulk is suspended.
